preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A TYPE OF RETARDER?
opcionesEn: ELECTRIC.
HYDRAULIC.
ROBOTIC.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE RIGS HAVE MORE CHANCES TO OFF-TRACK WHILE MAKING TURN?
opcionesEn: TRIPLE WITH 45-FEET TRAILER.
TRACTOR WITH TWO 27-FEET TRAILERS.
53-FEET STRAIGHT TRUCK.

preguntaEn: ACCORDING TO THE DRIVER’S MANUAL, WHY SHOULD YOU LIMIT THE USE OF YOUR HORN?
opcionesEn: IT CAN STARTLE OTHER DRIVERS.
ON VEHICLES WITH AIR BRAKES, IT CAN USE AIR PRESSURE THAT MAY BE NEEDED TO STOP.
YOU SHOULD KEEP A FIRM GRIP ON THE STEERING WHEEL WITH BOTH HANDS AT ALL TIMES.

preguntaEn: YOU CAN SEE A MAKING ON A VEHICLE AHEAD OF YOU.THE MARKING IS A RED TRIANGLE WITH AN ORANGE CENTER. WHAT DOES THE MARKING MEAN?
opcionesEn: IT MAY BE A SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE.
THE VEHICLE IS HAULING HAZARDOUS MATERIALS.
IT IS BEING DRIVEN BY A STUDENT DRIVER.

preguntaEn: CAN STATE INSPECTORS INSPECT YOUR TRUCK OR BUS?
opcionesEn: NO.
YES, BUT THEY CANNOT PUT IT OUT OF SERVICE.
YES, AND THEY CAN PUT IT OUT OF SERVICE IF IT IS UNSAFE.

preguntaEn: A KEY PRINCIPLE TO REMEMBER ABOUT LOADINF CARGO IS TO KEEP THE LOAD:
opcionesEn: TO THE FRONT.
TO THE REAR.
BALANCED IN THE CARGO AREA.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT COLD-WEATHER DRIVING IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: AN ENGINE CANNOT OVERHEAT WHEN THE WEATHER IS VERY COLD.
WINDSHIELD WASHER ANTIFREEZE SHOULD BE USED.
EXHAUST SYSTEM LEAKS ARE LESS DANGEROUS IN COLD WEATHER.

preguntaEn: WHEN IT IS NECESSARY TO LEARN HOW A FIRE EXTINGUISHER WORKS?
opcionesEn: BEFORE A FIRE HAPPENS.
ONLY WHEN A FIRE HAPPENS.
ONLY WHEN YOU ARE TRANSPORTING FLAMABLE MATERIALS.

preguntaEn: YOU MUST STOP ON A HILL OR CURVE ON A TWO-LANE TWO-WAY ROAD. HOW FAR SHOULD YOU PLACE REFLECTIVE TRIANGLES?
opcionesEn: AS FAR BACK AS NECESSARY SO OTHERS CAN SEE YOU.
WITHIN 200 FEET BEHIND YOU.
WITHIN 500 FEET BEHIND YOU.

preguntaEn: THE SAFEST METHOD FOR USING IN-VEHICLE COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT IS:
opcionesEn: PRE-PROGRAM YOUR CELL PHONE.
USE A HANDS-FREE DEVICE SO BOTH HANDS REMAIN ON THE STEERING WHEEL.
PULL OFF THE ROAD IN A SAFE, LEGAL PLACE TO USE THE EQUIPMENT.

preguntaEn: WHEN DRIVING THROUGH WORK ZONES, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: REDUCE YOUR SPEED ONLY IF WORKERS ARE CLOSE TO THE ROADWAY.
TURN ON YOUR PARKING LIGHTS.
WATCH FOR SHARP PAVEMENT DROP-OFFS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT DRUGS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: A DRIVER CAN USE ANY PRESCIPTION DRUG WHILE DRIVING.
AMPHETAMINES, (PEP PILLS OR BENNIES) CAN BE USED TO HELP THE DRIVER STAY ALERT.
THE USE OF DRUGS CAN LEAD TO AN ACCIDENT AND/OR ARREST.

preguntaEn: WHEN DRIVING IN COLD WEATHER, YOUR TIRE TREAD SHOULD:
opcionesEn: PROVIDE ENOUGH TRACTION TO STEER AND PUSH THE VEHICLE THROUGH SNOW.
BE DOUBLE THE DEPTH REQUIRED IN NORMAL WEATHER.
BE CHECKED EVERY 100 MILES OR EVERY TWO HOURS.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD ADJUST AND CHECK EACH MIRROR TO SHOW:
opcionesEn: SOME PART OF THE VEHICLE IS SHOWING.
YOU CAN SEE YOUR ENTIRE VEHICLE.
YOU DO NOT HAVE BLIND SPOT.

preguntaEn: THE TOTAL WEIGHT OF A POWERED UNIT, THE TRAILER, AND THE CARGO IS CALLED:
opcionesEn: GROSS COMBINATION WEIGHT.
GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT.
GROSS AXLE WEIGHT.

preguntaEn: THE SPEED AT WHICH YOU DRIVE SHOULD BE DETERMINE BY:
opcionesEn: YOUR SCHEDULE.
YOUR ENGINE TYPE.
YOUR VISIBILITY.

preguntaEn: THE BEST DRIVERS ARE THOSE WHO WATCH AND PREPARE FOR HAZARD. THIS IS CALLED THE ________ DRIVING.
opcionesEn: OFFENSIVE.
DEFENSIVE.
OBJECTIVE.

preguntaEn: WHCICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT DRIVING IN AREAS WITH STRONG WIND IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: YOU SHOULD DRIVE ALONSIDE OTHER VEHICLES TO HELP BREAK UP THE WIND.
THE LIGHTER YOUR VEHICLE, THE LESS TROUBLE YOU WILL HAVE WITH THE WIND.
WINDS ARE ESPECIALLY A PROBLEM WHEN COMING OUT OF TUNNELS.

preguntaEn: WHAT KIND OF OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT (EXCEPT TIRE WRENCH) COULD BE IN YOUR VEHICLE?
opcionesEn: FULLY CHARGED FIRE EXTINGUISHER.
SET OF WARNING DEVICE.
BATTERY CHARGER.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT SHIPPING HAZARDOUS MATERIALS IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: GAS CYLINDERS THAT WILL NOT HOLD A LABEL MUST BE SHIPPED UNDER COVER.
A DIAMOND-SHAPED HAZARDOUS MATERIALS LABEL MUST BE ON THE CONTAINER.
A CIRCULAR, RED HAZARDOUS MATERIAL LABEL MUST BE ON THE CONTAINER.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS ABOUT PRE-TRIP INSPECTION IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: IF PARKED ON A STREET, YOU SHOULD WALK SO THAT YOU FACE AWAY FROM AN ONCOMING TRAFFIC.
LEAVE THE KEY IN THE IGNITION SO YOU DO NOT LOOSE IT WHILE YOU ARE UNDER THE TRUCK.
IF YOU NEED TO TILT THE CAB, SECURE LOOSE THINGS SO THEY DO NOT FALL AND BREAK ANYTHING.

preguntaEn: TO DETERMINE BLOOD ALCOHOL CONCENTRATION (BAC) FOR A PERSON IT IS NECESSARY TO KNOW:
opcionesEn: HOW OFTEN THE PERSON DRINKS ALCOHOL (TOLERANCE LEVEL).
HOW MUCH THE PERSON WEGHS.
HOW OLD THE PERSON IS.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE DRIVING A LONG VEHICLE THAT MAKES WIDE TURNS. YOU WANT TO TURN LEFT FROM ONE STREET ONTO ANOTHER. BOTH ARE TWO-LANE TWO-WAY STREETS. YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: BEGING TURNING YOUR VEHICLE AS SOON AS YOU ENTER THE INTERSECTION.
BEGING TURNING YOUR VEHICLE WHEN YOU ARE HALFWAY THROUGH INTERSECTION.
TURN INTO THE LEFT LANE OF POPLAR STREET AND THEN MOVE TO THE RIGHT LANE WHEN THE TRAFFIC IS CLEAR.

preguntaEn: WHICH STATEMENT IS TRUE ABOUT USING ENGINE BRAKING?
opcionesEn: IT CREATES EXTRA HEAT BETWEEN THE BRAKE SHOES OR PADS AND DRUM(S) OR DISKS.
YOU SHOULD NOT USE ENGINE BREAKING AS THE MAIN WAY TO CONTROL SPEED.
THE USE OF BRAKES ON A DOWNGRADE ADDS TO THE BRAKING EFFECT OF THE ENGINE.

preguntaEn: WHY IS IT IMPORTANT TO SHIFT GEARS CORRECTLY?
opcionesEn: KEEP CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE.
KEEP THE ENGINE WARM.
KEEP THE ENGINE OIL FLOWING.

preguntaEn: YOU MUST PARK ON THE SIDE OF A LEVEL, STRAIGHT, FOUR-LANE DIVIDED HIGHWAY. WHERE SHOULD YOU PLACE THE REFLECTIVE TRIANGLES?
opcionesEn: ONE WITHIN 10 FEET OF THE REAR OF THE VEHICLE, ONE ABOUT 100 FEET TO THE REAR, AND ONE ABOUT 200 FEET TO THE REAR.
ONE WITHIN 10 FEET OF THE REAR OF THE VEHICLE, ONE ABOUT 100 FEET TO THE REAR, AND ONE ABOUT 100 FEET TO THE FRONT OF THE VEHICLE.
ONE WITHIN 10 FEET OF THE FRONT OF THE VEHICLE, ONE ABOUT 100 FEET TO THE REAR, AND ONE ABOUT 200 FEET TO THE REAR.

preguntaEn: MEDICINE USED TO TREAT THE COMMON COLD:
opcionesEn: SHOULD ONLY BE USED WHEN DRIVING AT DAYTIME.
OFTEN MAKES YOU SLEEPY AND THUS SHOULD NOT BE USED WHILE DRIVING.
CAN STILL BE USED WHILE DRIVING IF YOU ONLY TAKE HALF THE REGULAR DOSAGE.

preguntaEn: HOW FAR SHOULD A DRIVER LOOK AHEAD OF THE VEHICLE WHILE DRIVING?
opcionesEn: 5-8 SECONDS.
12-15 SECONDS.
18-21 SECONDS.

preguntaEn: A VEHICLE IS LOADED WITH VERY LITTLE WEIGHT ON THE DRIVE AXLE. WHAT MAY HAPPEN?
opcionesEn: POOR TRACTION.
DAMAGE TO DRIVE AXLE TIRES.
BETTER HANDLING.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE REQUIRED TO INSPECT YOUR TRUCK WITHIN HOW MANY MILES AFTER BEGINNING THE TRIP?
WHAT SHOULD YOU DO IF YOU ARE UNSURE WHETHER YOU HAVE ENOUGH OVERHEAD CLEARENCE?
opcionesEn: SLOW DOWN SLIGHTLY AND TRY TO DRIVE UNDER THE OBJECT.
FIND ANOTHER ROUTE THAT WILL NOT REQUIRE DRIVING UNDER THE OBJECT.
ESTIMATE THE HEIGHT OF AN OVERHEAD OBJECT IF IT IS NOT POSTED.

preguntaEn: THE SPACE_________ YOU VEHICLE IS THE MOST IMPORTANT TO MANAGE.
opcionesEn: IN BACK OF.
IN FRONT OF.
TO THE SIDE OF.

preguntaEn: CONVEX (CURVED) MIRRORS:
opcionesEn: MAKE OBJECTS APPEAR CLOSER THAN THEY REALLY ARE.
MAKE OBJECTS APPEAR LARGER THAN THEY REALLY ARE.
SHOW A WIDER AREA THAN FLAT MIRRORS SHOW.

preguntaEn: YOU SHOULD SIGNAL CONTINUOUSLY WHILE TURNING BECAUSE:
opcionesEn: YOU NEED BOTH HANDS ON THE WHEEL TO TURN SAFELY.
IT IS ILLEGAL TO TURN OFF YOUR SIGNAL BEFORE COMPLETING THE TURN.
MOST VEHICLE HAVE SELF-CANCELING SIGNALS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A DANGER WHEN AN AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION IS FORCED INTO A LOW GEAR AT A HIGH SPEED?
opcionesEn: DAMAGE TO THE TRANSMISSION.
LOSS OF ENGINE BRAKING EFFECT.
LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS TRUE ABOUT REAR DRIVE WHEEL BRAKING SKIDS?
opcionesEn: LOCKED WHEELS USUALLY HAVE MORE TRACTION THAN ROLLING WHEELS.
FRONT WHEELS SLIDE SIDEWAY TO TRY TO CATCH UP WITH THE REAR WHEELS.
ON A VEHICLE WITH A TRAILER THE TRAILER CAN PUSH THE TOWING VEHICLE SIDE WAYS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THIS IS TRUE ABOUT OTHER DRIVERS.
opcionesEn: MAIL OR DELIVERY TRUCKS ARE PROFESSIONALS AND DO NOT POSE A HAZARD.
DRIVERS USING TURN SIGNALS CAN ALWAYS BE TRUSTED TO TURN IN THE DIRECTION THEY INDICATE.
SHORT-TERM OR DAILY RENTAL TRUCK DRIVERS ARE OFTEN NOT USED TO THE LIMITED VISION AND POSE THE HAZARD.

preguntaEn: IN THE EVENT OF A REAR TIRE FAILURE, DUAL REAR TIRE:
opcionesEn: WILL USUALLY PRENT FISHTAIL.
MAY PREVENT VIBRATION OR THUMPING.
WILL ALLOW YOU TO BRAKE IMMEDIATELY.

preguntaEn: WHEN EXITING OR ENTERING ON A CURVED FREEWAY RAMP, YOU SHOULD:
opcionesEn: MAINTAIN A SPEED 5-10 MPH UNDER THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT.
MAINTAIN THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT.
SLOW DOWN TO AT LEAST 50% OF THE POSTED SPEED LIMIT.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE IS A GOOD THING TO DO WHEN STEERING TO AVOID CRASH?
opcionesEn: APPLY THE BRAKES WHILE TURNING.
STEER WITH ONE HAND SO THAT YOU CAN TURN THE WHEEL MORE QUICKLY.
DON’T TURN ANYMORE THAN NEEDED TO CLEAR WHAT IS IN YOUR WAY.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THE FOLLOWING IS A GOOD WAY TO REACT TO AN AGGRESSIVE DRIVER?
opcionesEn: GIVE THE DRIVER THE BENEFIT OF THE DOUBT.
CHANGING THE CD OR HAVE A SNACK.
SMOKE A CIGARETTE TO RELAX.

preguntaEn: YOU ARE CHECKING YOUR BRAKES AND SUSPENSION SYSTEM FOR A PRE-TRIP INSPECTION. WHICH OF THESE STATEMENT IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: JUST ONE MISSING LEAF SPRING IS NOT DANGEROUS.
SPRING HANGERS THAT ARE CRACKED BUT STILL TIGHT ARE NOT DANGEROUS.
BRAKE SHOES SHOULD NOT HAVE OIL, GREASE, OR BRAKE FLUID ON THEM.

preguntaEn: WHAT SHOULD YOU DO IF A CAR COMING TOWARD YOU AT NIGHT KEEPS ITS HIGH BEAMS ON?
opcionesEn: FLASH YOU HIGH BEAMS QUICKLY AT THE OTHER DRIVER.
LOOK TO THE RIGHT LANE OR EDGE MARKINGS OF THE ROAD.
SLOW DOWN AND LOOK STRAIGHT AHEAD IN YOUR LANE.

preguntaEn: IT IS UNSAFE TO OPERATE A VEHICLE WITH HOW MANY CRACKED, BROKEN OR MISSING SPRING LEAVES IN ANY LEAF SPRING:
opcionesEn: ONE-THRID OF THE TOTAL NUMBER.
ONE-HALF OF THE TOTAL NUMBER.
ONE-FOURTH OF THE TOTAL NUMBER.

preguntaEn: WHEN YOU ARE DRIVING ON GRADES, WHICH OF THESE IS THE BEST WAY TO CHOOSE A SAFE SPEED?
opcionesEn: BASED ON YOUR VEHICLE AND ITS CARGO, SELECT A SAFE SPEED THAT IS WITHIN THE POSTED SPEED.
FOLLOW THE VEHICLE IN FRONT OF YOU.
IF YOU HAVE A LIGHT LOAD, YOU CAN GO FASTER THAN THOSE WITH A HEAVY LOAD.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THE FOLLOWING ABOUT ANTILOCK BRAKING SYSTEM IS TRUE?
opcionesEn: ABS ALLOWS YOU TO DRIVE FASTER, FOLLOW MORE CLOSELY OR DRIVE LESS CAREFULLY.
ABS PREVENTS POWER OR TURNING SKIDS.
ABS CHANGES THE WAY YOU BRAKE IN AN EMERGENCY.

preguntaEn: THE TREAD DEPTH ON A FRONT STEERING WHEELS TIRES SHOULD BE:
opcionesEn: NOT LESS THAN 4/32 (FOUR THIRTY TWO) INCH.
MORE THAN 6/32 (SIX THIRTY TWO) INCH.
NOT LESS THAN 2/32 (TWO THIRTY TWO) INCH.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE LIGHTS CANNOT BE CHECKED AT THE SAME TIME?
opcionesEn: TURN SIGNALS, TAILLIGHTS, AND CLEARANCE LIGHTS.
TURN SIGNALS, BRAKE LIGHTS, AND FOUR-WAY FLASHERS.
HEADLIGHTS, BRAKE LIGHTS, AND CLEARANCE LIGHTS.

preguntaEn: WHICH OF THESE ACTIONS ARE NOT RECOMMENDED FOR A LEFT TURN?
opcionesEn: START AT THE INSIDE LANE AND SWING RIGHT AS YOU TURN.
USE A RIGHT-HAND TURN LANE IF THERE ARE TWO TURNING LANES.
START YOUR TURN IN THE CENTER OF THE INTERSECTION.

preguntaEn: THE AMOUNT OF THE BRAKE PRESSURE YOU NEED TO STOP THE VEHICLE WILL DEPEND ON:
opcionesEn: WETHER THE VEHICLE IS EQUIPEED WITH ANTILOCK BRAKES.
THE VEHICLE’S SPEED AND HOW QUICKLY YOU WANT TO STOP.
THE TYE OF BRAKE THE VEHICLE HAS.
